classification: Replay of an already published source result, not a prospective preregistration
question: Can the source grid and native-pixel classifier reproduce its six disputed base-60 cell readings from the archived LP2-49–51 JPEGs?
blind_read_gate: At least 38 of 40 exact token readings in the source's frozen calibration record; this replay can rescore the saved reads but cannot recreate their claimed blindness.
automated_controls: Run the original pixel matcher including render-determinism and leave-one-out checks. Compare source discrete outputs independently; do not treat the source's own script agreement as an independent reading of the JPEGs.
limits: The source records its human visual passes, which cannot be reproduced by automation. This is image-token adjudication, not a decipherment of the 256-byte payload.
